mechanism: St. John's Wort induces CYP3A4 and CYP1A2, reducing cyclobenzaprine plasma concentrations and efficacy, while additive CNS depression may occur through serotonergic and GABAergic pathways.
action: Monitor for reduced muscle relaxant efficacy; consider alternative herbal supplement or adjust cyclobenzaprine dosing if concurrent use necessary; counsel on additive CNS depressant effects.
